Expandable Container House


Expandable container houses are a modern modular housing solution designed for fast installation, easy transportation, and flexible space expansion. They are ideal for residential homes, temporary housing, hotels, offices, and commercial projects.

Our expandable container houses are available in various configurations to meet your specific space requirements, such as 10ft, 20ft, 30ft, and 40ft models. Each unit can be configured for different uses, from compact living units to multi-room spaces.

Please browse our following expandable container house floor plans and contact us for a quote on your ideal design solution.

Why Choose an Expandable Container House?


An expandable container house is a prefabricated modular unit that can be folded for transport and expanded on site to create a larger space. Compared with traditional construction, key advantages are as follows:

- Foldable design for easier transportation and storage.

- Expandable structure for a more usable interior space.

- Prefabricated construction for easy installation and faster project delivery.

- Customizable flexibility layouts, including bedrooms, bathrooms, kitchens, and living areas.

- Suitable for both temporary and permanent residences.

- Durable construction, designed for long-term performance in different environments.

Expandable Container Houses Applications


- Residential Use: Family homes, tiny houses, granny flats, vacation cabins, community housing.

- Commercial & Hospitality: Airbnb rentals, luxury resorts, temporary offices, commercial showrooms.

Partner with NEW BRAND


NEW BRAND supports OEM and ODM customization, factory production, technical guidance, and after-sales service. Every expandable home unit available options include footprint, room layout, doors and windows, insulation, flooring, interior decoration, electrical systems, plumbing, kitchens, and bathrooms.

If you are looking for a practical and scalable modular housing solution, our expandable container houses offer a combination of speed, flexibility, and value. Contact us to discuss your project and get a customized quote.

Compact Prefab Container House: Foldable, Expandable & Moveable- Free Sample!
The Compact Prefab Container House is a versatile and innovative housing solution that is foldable, expandable, and easily movable. Its compact design allows for convenient transportation and quick assembly, making it an ideal choice for those seeking a flexible and comfortable living space.
Ultimate Customizable Expandable Prefab Home: 3-in-1 Double-Wing Foldable Container with Bathroom & Kitchen
The Factory Customized Expandable Container Prefab House is a versatile and convenient 3-in-1 collapsible shipping container home. With its built-in bathroom and kitchen, this double wing folding prefabricated house offers a practical and customizable living space solution.
Expandable Prefab 40ft Tiny House: Portable, Customizable & Modern Living Solution
The Expandable Prefab 40ft Tiny House offers a portable and modern living solution with its customizable design. Ideal for those seeking a compact yet functional space, this tiny house can be expanded effortlessly to cater to different needs and preferences.
Spacious 2-Bedroom Luxury Prefab Home: Expandable 40ft Container House
The Spacious 2-Bedroom Luxury Prefab Home is an expandable 40ft container house, designed to provide a luxurious living space with two bedrooms. Built with high-quality materials, this home offers modern amenities in a compact yet comfortable environment.
Ultimate 3-in-1 Luxury Prefab Fold House: Customizable, Expandable, and Portable!
The Ultimate 3-in-1 Luxury Prefab Fold House is a state-of-the-art, customizable, and portable solution that offers unparalleled luxury and convenience. With its innovative design, the fold house can be easily expanded or relocated, providing a truly flexible and exquisite living experience.
Expandable Container House - Fully Furnished, 2 Bedroom Prefab Home
The Expandable Container House is a fully furnished, two-bedroom prefab home that offers an innovative and versatile living space. With its expandable design, it provides ample room for comfortable living while maintaining a compact footprint, making it an ideal solution for modern, sustainable living.
Premium 3-in-1 Foldable Container Home: Customizable Luxury Living Solution from Australia
The Premium 3-in-1 Foldable Container Home from Australia offers a customizable and luxurious living solution. With its innovative design and versatility, it provides a perfect blend of functionality and style for those seeking a unique and contemporary living space.
Affordable Portable Container Home: Expandable & Customizable Prefab Garden House from China
The "Affordable Portable Container Home" is a versatile prefab garden house originating from China, offering expandable and customizable features. With its affordable pricing and portability, it provides an ideal solution for those seeking a flexible and personalized living space.
Expandable 3-in-1 Portable Kids Play House with Bedroom and Bathroom: Custom Prefab Container Home
The "Expandable 3-in-1 Portable Kids Play House with Bedroom and Bathroom: Custom Prefab Container Home" is a versatile and compact playhouse designed specifically for children. With a built-in bedroom and bathroom, this customizable prefab container home provides a fun and interactive space for kids to play and imagine.
Luxury Expandable Container House - With Bathroom & Kitchen, Customizable & Spacious!
This luxury expandable container house offers a customizable and spacious living experience, complete with a bathroom and kitchen. With its innovative design, it provides the perfect blend of comfort and style for those seeking a contemporary and convenient housing solution.
Custom 40 Ft Luxury Tiny Modular Prefab Container Houses Folding Expandable Prefabricated Home With Glass Window
The Custom 40 Ft Luxury Tiny Modular Prefab Container Houses are innovative and stylish compact living solutions. With glass windows that provide ample natural light, these folding and expandable prefabricated homes offer a comfortable and modern living space.
Suppliers Custom Foldable Container Prefab Houses 3 In 1 Double Wing Expandable Prefabricated Home With Two Bedrooms
This supplier specializes in providing custom foldable container prefab houses that are 3 in 1 and have a double wing expandable design, offering a convenient and flexible solution for a prefabricated home with two bedrooms.
